_about: NEW SPECIES intake record — one file per new species, filled DATA-FIRST before any design work starts (see NEW-SPECIES-SHEET-TEMPLATE.md for the workflow and gates). Shapes copy the lane's existing formats exactly: the core record follows src/data/core/species.json + schemas/species.schema.json; the dex block follows src/lib/generated/dexEntryMedia-20261026.json entries; the footprint block follows FOOTPRINT-MANIFEST-51-20261026.json entries. Replace every <...> placeholder. A field with no canon source yet stays null/empty and is added to TBD-REGISTER.md — never invented.

body_block.body_plan: <e.g. compact_round / bipedal_amphibian / bulky_bruiser / small_feline / small_plant_biped / ghost_float — cast.json vocabulary, extended as needed>
body_block.distinguishing_anatomy: <the 2-4 features a silhouette must survive: read at 16px>
body_block.height: <TBD D5 — owner/lane set at sheet time>

core_record.dexText: <bio_short: one-line dex entry in the house voice (style reference: the 12 locked entries in species.json)>
core_record.hpStatus: ok | pending-decision: <reason> (null stats are never guessed — Pebblefist precedent)
core_record.name: <owner-locked name>
core_record.provenance: <sources for every value, e.g. 'owner intake sheet 2026-..; stats owner-locked; dexText drafted <by>, owner-approved <date>'>
types: <1-2 Mochiichao elements: Aqua/Flame/Flora/Chrome/Core/Umbral/Mythic/Beast/Strike/Bug/Silk/Aero/Wind/Neon/Earth — element vocabulary per TBD D6>

dex_entry._rules: footprint_rule: footprint shows for CAUGHT entries only. cry_rule: play-cry for seen/caught, default V1. (dexEntryMedia-20261026.json)
dex_entry.footprint_status: PENDING until the footprint is derived and owner/lane confirmed

footprint_manifest_entry.foot_type: <anatomy-derived: paw / talon / fin contact / ... — from the finished design's feet/contact surface, never invented ahead of the design>
footprint_manifest_entry.source_view: <walk/battle cell the print was traced from>
footprint_manifest_entry.toe_note: <what is and isn't resolvable, in the manifest's own honest style>

learnset.source: <intake: verified at intake, or 'provisional baseline' flagged like the 35>

gate0_numbering.core_id: <3-digit string, next free in the CANONICAL scheme — blocked on TBD D1: core sequence (001-047 used) vs dex sequence (001-046, 147, 148, 331 used). Owner rules the scheme, then this id is issued. Do not self-assign.>
gate0_numbering.dex_id: <same id in a unified scheme; if the schemes stay split, the dex-registry id issued by the dex lane>

natural_history_block._status: PROPOSED extension — no lane location exists yet (TBD W2/W3). Fill it here at intake so the data exists the day the lane picks a home for it.

show_block.locomotion: <how it moves — feeds POSING-SYSTEM / rig spec>
show_block.signature_move: <canon move mapping if any — per-species, from game canon, never a shared template>

voice_block.cry_description: <written description of the cry: pure cries/sounds only — no words, no name-saying (canon law)>

cry_block._about: CRY SYNTH block internals per the species-systems schema patch (show/production/species-systems/species-sheet-schema-patch-cry.md + cry-schema-fragment.json). A sheet is not complete until its cry block exists, even as draft. Pure cries only.
cry_block.identity_note: <sound identity, SHOW-BIBLE S4 style, written FIRST>
